title: Content level
hint: The platform only publishes content that uplifts the audience: level 400 and above on the consciousness scale. Choose your content's level.
accept: I declare the level and take responsibility for this content
acceptHint: Content outside the standard can be taken down by Groscove.

400.name: Reason
400.body: Informs and explains: data, technique, learning, clear reasoning.

500.name: Love
500.body: Care and warmth: inspires, supports, cares for the audience.

540.name: Joy
540.body: Lightness and celebration: entertains without putting anyone down.

700.name: Enlightenment
700.body: Transcendence: purpose, spirituality, the bigger meaning of things.

groscove.takedownBody: The content goes offline for everyone. The Hero sees the reason in My content.
groscove.failed: Could not take it down. Try again.
